name: Huakai Yibai Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Huakai Yibai Technology Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides environmental art design services in China and internationally. The company offers various cultural theme space display systems for large indoor spaces, such as exhibition halls and showrooms. It is also involved in cross-border export e-commerce; information technology services; supply chain and enterprise management services; and exhibition setup project. The company was formerly known as Hunan Huakai Cultural and Creative Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Huakai Yibai Technology Co.,Ltd. in April 2022. Huakai Yibai Technology Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Changsha, China.
